next_record_only_options: Search only separately authorized existing execution logs/snapshots for a run-linked source tree or dirty patch, checkpoint/content digest, scalar calibration identity and environment/invocation. No such binding was found in this bounded review.
If no stronger attestation is available, retain exact historical component as provenance-blocked. Do not substitute nearest dated commit/currentHEAD/currentdefault.
A candidate emulation would require separate payload-inspection/runtime permissions and would remain a reconstruction candidate unless authenticated. Do not label it an exact rerun.

separate_current_version_study_boundary.interpretation: A newly pinned current-version controlled-synthetic audio→output test would answer a new version-bounded question only. It cannot retroactively satisfy old unrun gate or validate old latency.
prerequisites_if_authorized: Preregister/freeze the complete source tree and external calibration/checkpoint bytes with exact output boundary.
Set audio timing, future perturbation, priming/state, stochastic seeds and all heads/postprocessing/DMX outputs explicitly.
Include future-sensitive beat-grid/oracle paths in a whole-path claim; excluding them narrows the tested claim.
Approve model/checkpoint inspection, CPU feature work and GPU inference/runtime budget separately. No model training or body retiming is implied.
